content.title: DBACKS.TV
content.text: Back again for the 2026 season, Arizonans can watch all D-backs games in-market both LIVE and on-demand (subject to national exclusivities) during the 2026 season with a DBACKS.TV subscription. This offer is available for only $99.99 for the full season or $19.99/month. Start a 7-day free trial today! (*Subject to national exclusivities.) This offer is only for D-backs fans in the Club’s Home Television Territory and is a separate service than the MLB.TV out of market package. By offering a direct-to-consumer streaming option on DBACKS.TV in the Club’s territory, MLB is able to lift the blackout for D-backs games previously distributed on Bally Sports Arizona. How do I watch the D-backs in their home territory? To find a list of available carriers, please enter your zip code on the Channel Finder- Where to Watch Page below. To stream D-backs games, please visit Dbacks.TV for full details. Where to Watch How Do I Stream the D-backs games in the Arizona area? DBACKS.TV subscribers are able to access available Arizona Diamondbacks games in the Arizona area with NO BLACKOUTS and nationwide (subject to national exclusivities and local blackout restrictions). This offer is only for D-backs fans in the Club’s Home Television Territory and is a separate service than the MLB.TV out of market package. How do I watch D-backs baseball if I live outside of the Arizona area? Existing out-of-market Yearly and Monthly MLB.TV subscribers, including subscribers who received a subscription via T-Mobile, can continue to watch Arizona Diamondbacks games on MLB.TV outside of the Arizona area. Non-subscribers will need to purchase an MLB.TV Yearly or Monthly subscription in order to watch. Full details on all MLB.TV product offerings can be found here. Can MLB.TV All Teams Subscribers Watch D-Backs games on MLB.TV in the Arizona area? Only users that have specifically purchased the 2026 DBACKS.TV Package or the DBACKS.TV / MLB.TV Bundle subscription will be able to stream D-backs games in the Arizona area. MLB.TV All Teams subscribers will not have access and will need to purchase DBACKS.TV in order to stream D-backs games in the Arizona area. If I’m a D-backs Advantage Member / Season Ticket Member with MLB.TV, what does this mean for me? D-backs Season Ticket Members receive a free MLB.TV All Teams Subscription as a membership benefit. However, only users that specifically purchase a DBACKS.TV subscription will be able to stream D-backs games in Arizona. Members need to add-on this package. Members should not enable their free MLB.TV All Teams subscription to watch D-backs home games. Instead, they should enable their subscription for DBACKS.TV. What talent will be broadcasting and calling the games on the new MLB broadcast? The D-backs primary TV broadcasters - Steve Berthiaume and Bob Brenly - will continue to serve in their existing roles. Blackout Policy Due to certain Major League Baseball national exclusivities, select regular season, special event, and Postseason games are unavailable on MLB.TV domestically and internationally. Live audio of all 30 MLB teams is included with DBACKS.TV subscriptions. Purchasers of DBACKS.TV have access to in-market live-streaming games: click here for full details. Web: Select the Arizona Diamondbacks game you wish to view from the Multimedia Center. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. As long as the computer meets the system requirements then you can log in with your registered email address and password to access your subscription from anywhere at any time. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Mobile & Connected Devices To watch Arizona Diamondbacks games on mobile and connected devices, download the MLB app and select the game you wish to view. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Device Availability For a full list of supported devices click here DBACKS.TV Support If you are having issues accessing a game or have questions about your account you can visit our full online Support Page. You can also call our toll-free support (866.244.2291), email by clicking here, on Social @MLBFanSupport or via Virtual Assistant. Payment Methods Accepted payment methods include: MasterCard, Visa, American Express, Discover, Masterpass, and PayPal. Please note: The payment and billing information entered above will be stored as your primary payment card in the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account. If you save alternative payment cards to the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account, you authorize us to charge such payment card(s) in the event we are unable to process charges to the primary payment card entered above. If the account number, expiration date or debit card account associated with your subscription changes, update it as soon as possible. Please also be aware, MLB may acquire this current information from our financial services partner(s) and update the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account to include such revised payment information. Free Trial Policy You may cancel a 7-day risk-free trial of DBACKS.TV Yearly or DBACKS.TV Monthly any time during the 7-day window and will still have access to DBACKS.TV for the full 7 days. If you do not cancel, you will be billed on the eighth day for the current Yearly or Monthly subscription price. MLB reserves the right to determine customer eligibility for trial memberships in its sole discretion. If you purchased the DBACKS.TV monthly subscription, the payment card you have on file with us will be billed monthly on approximately the same monthly date that you originally purchased, with monthly billing for each month of the 2026 MLB season through and including September. You can verify your monthly billing date in your MLB Account under “Manage Subscriptions.” GovX Discount Exclusive discount for current and former military. Customers receive a 35% discount to select Club.TV subscriptions. The discount can only be applied by selecting the GOVX option in the checkout flow. DBACKS.TV Cancellation Policy You may easily cancel your DBACKS.TV subscription any time before your next billing period in your MLB Account, under the Manage Subscriptions tab, or by contacting customer service at 866-244-2291 or contacting us here. (International Customers please call 315-203-6761). DBACKS.TV Auto-renewal Details DBACKS.TV Yearly: By clicking “Buy and accept terms,” you agree to the MLB.com Terms of Use and the MLB.com Privacy Policy. You also agree that your subscription to DBACKS.TV Yearly will automatically renew annually on or about March 1 at the then-current year’s regular full yearly price. You can cancel your automatic renewal any time before the billing period. DBACKS.TV Monthly: By clicking “Buy & Accept Terms,” you agree to the MLB.com Terms of Use and the MLB.com Privacy Policy. You also agree that your subscription to DBACKS.TV Monthly will renew monthly through and including September, and will automatically renew annually on or about March 1 each year at the then-current year’s regular full monthly price. You can cancel your automatic renewal any time before the billing period.
